what: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
text: function calculates various geometric hydrological metrics Digital Elevation Model (dtm). computes terrain attributes, performs hydrological processing (including inverted processing ridge extraction), returns metrics structured list.

title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
code: calc_geomorph_metrics(   dtm,   output_folder = tempdir(),   contour_interval = 10,   stream_threshold = 1000,   breach_dist = 50,   hillshade_angle = 45,   hillshade_direction = 270 )

title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
text: dtm SpatRaster object imported terra::rast(). Must valid digital elevation model. output_folder Character string specifying directory path temporary whitebox processing files. Defaults temporary directory. contour_interval Numeric value contour line spacing elevation units. Default 10. stream_threshold Numeric value stream ridge extraction threshold (number cells). Default 1000. Adjust based study area size. breach_dist Maximum breach distance depression filling cells. Default 50. hillshade_angle Sun angle hillshade calculation degrees. Default 45. hillshade_direction Sun direction hillshade calculation degrees. Default 270 (west).

title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
text: list containing following geometric metrics: contours sf object contour lines slope SpatRaster slope degrees aspect SpatRaster aspect radians hillshade SpatRaster hillshade dtm_filled SpatRaster depression-filled dtm flow_pointer SpatRaster D8 flow pointers flow_acc SpatRaster flow accumulation flow_acc_log SpatRaster log-transformed flow accumulation streams SpatRaster extracted stream network dtm_inverted SpatRaster inverted dtm (ridge analysis) dtm_filled_inverted SpatRaster depression-filled inverted dtm flow_pointer_inverted SpatRaster D8 flow pointers inverted dtm flow_acc_inverted SpatRaster flow accumulation inverted dtm streams_inverted SpatRaster extracted streams_inverted output_folder Character string output folder path used

title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
text: function performs following calculations order: Basic terrain attributes (contours, slope, aspect, hillshade) Depression filling using least-cost breaching D8 flow pointer calculation Flow accumulation Log-transformed flow accumulation Stream network extraction Inverted dtm creation (dtm * -1) Inverted hydrological processing (ridge extraction) Ridge network extraction inverted hydrological processing creates "reversed" topography valleys become ridges vice versa. allows extraction ridge networks using flow accumulation algorithms used streams.

title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
text: Requires terra, whitebox, sf packages. Make sure whitebox tools properly installed whitebox::install_whitebox().

title: Calculate Geomorphology Metrics from dtm — calc_geomorph_metrics
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{  # Load your dtm dtm <- rast("path/to/your/dtm.tif")  # Calculate all metrics with defaults metrics <- calc_geomorphology_metrics(dtm)  # Access individual metrics plot(metrics$slope) plot(metrics$hillshade) plot(metrics$streams) plot(metrics$streams_inverted)  # Custom parameters metrics <- calc_geomorphology_metrics(   dtm = dtm,   output_folder = "C:/my_project/temp",   contour_interval = 20,   stream_threshold = 500 ) } # }

title: Extract Main Ridge Lines from dtm — extract_main_ridges
text: function follows workflow: Extract flow accumulation values ridge segment Aggregate TRIB_ID find maximum flow per tributary Select top N tributaries flow accumulation Merge segments within selected tributary Add RANK attribute (1 = highest flow) Note: Flow accumulation extracted individual segments merging ensure accurate values. tools may merge first, leading incorrect results.

title: Extract Main Valley Lines from dtm — extract_main_valleys
text: version matches QGIS plugin behavior : Rasterizing valley lines extract flow accumulation pixel centers Removing confluence points (pixels touch multiple TRIB_IDs) Ranking tributaries highest non-confluence flow accumulation point function follows workflow: Rasterize valley lines identify cells containing valleys Extract flow accumulation values valley cell centers Create points cell centers flow values Spatially join points valley lines (buffer = half cell size) Remove points belong multiple TRIB_IDs (confluence points) TRIB_ID, find single point highest flow accumulation Rank tributaries maximum non-confluence flow value Select top N tributaries Merge segments within selected tributary Add RANK attribute (1 = highest flow) Preserve CRS input valleys Note: method differs simple terra::extract() excluding confluence points multiple tributaries meet, preventing "flow accumulation theft" short segments confluences.

title: Extract Main Valley Lines from dtm — extract_main_valleys
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ dtm <- rast("path/to/dtm.tif")  # Calculate metrics (REQUIRED) metrics <- calc_geomorph_metrics(dtm)  # Extract valley network (REQUIRED) valleys <- extract_networks(dtm, type = "valley", metrics = metrics)  # Extract main valleys (QGIS-compatible method) main_valleys <- extract_main_valleys(   valleys = valleys,   dtm = dtm,   nr_main = 2,   metrics = metrics ) } # }

title: Terrain Analysis with Stream Network Visualization — plot_slope_channels
text: dtm SpatRaster. dtm raster object terra package. metrics Optional. list object returned calc_geomorph_metrics(). NULL, function calculate metrics internally. Default NULL. contour_interval Numeric. Elevation interval contour lines. Default 10. stream_threshold Numeric. Threshold value stream extraction (number cells). Higher values result fewer streams. Default 1000. hillshade_angle Numeric. Sun elevation angle hillshade calculation (0-90 degrees). Default 45. hillshade_direction Numeric. Sun azimuth direction hillshade (0-360 degrees). Default 270. contour_color Character. Color contour lines. Default "darkorange4". contour_width Numeric. Line width contours. Default 1. label_size Numeric. Size contour labels. Default 0.8. slope_alpha Numeric. Transparency slope overlay (0-1). Default 0.6. stream_color Character. Color stream network. Default "blue". stream_width Numeric. Line width streams. Default 1. main_title Character. Plot title. Default "Slope contours streams".
